text.en: MaskFeat is row 18 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: MaskFeat 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 18 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates MaskFeat with “Masked feature prediction for self-supervised visual pre-training”.
text.zh: 年度表把 MaskFeat 与论文《Masked feature prediction for self-supervised visual pre-training》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Chen Wei, Christoph Feichtenhofer”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Chen Wei（官方页拼写）、Christoph Feichtenhofer（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Chen Wei, Christoph Feichtenhofer”。
